name: Registry help
description: Help mode entries for the Registry page (help@1).
author: Brett

entries.title: Search
entries.text: Words, an entry id or an alias. Finds every controllable thing in every app: pages, plugins, tools, display options, settings.

entries.title: App
entries.text: Show only one app's entries: the console, Molly, axHub, Hostinger, Coolify, the VPS, AmberX or Moshi.

entries.title: Type
entries.text: Show only one kind: page, app, plugin, tool, behaviour, display option or setting.

entries.title: Reached by
entries.text: Show only entries a surface reaches: REST, MCP, the CLI, voice or a deep link.

entries.title: Gaps
entries.text: Show only entries with gaps (something not controllable yet, with the reason), or only complete ones.

entries.title: Run
entries.text: Runs this action now with the values above. The registry checks every value first; a delete asks for a confirm, and anything through axHub waits for your approval there.

entries.title: Plan only
entries.text: Shows exactly what would run (the control@1 command, the axHub call or the link) without running anything.

entries.title: Confirm and run
entries.text: Runs a destructive action with the confirm token the first try gave back.

entries.title: Read state
entries.text: Reads this entry's current state through its state read, without changing anything.

entries.title: Resolve
entries.text: Finds the entry and action a phrase means, the way voice does: exact names, aliases and phrases only. Claude is asked only when nothing matches and the Claude fallback is on.

entries.title: Resolve and run
entries.text: Resolves the phrase and runs what it found, with the same checks as Run.

entries.title: Say or type
entries.text: A phrase the way you would say it to AmberX ("open plan studio", "restart the vps"). Resolve shows which entry and action it means; nothing runs until you tap Resolve and run.

entries.title: Registry
entries.text: Everything you can control in the console, Molly, axHub, Hostinger, Coolify, the VPS, AmberX and Moshi, with every action and allowed value, and how each is reached by REST, MCP, the CLI and voice.

entries.title: Registry settings
entries.text: Install or uninstall the Registry page. The registry itself (the offline index and the API) stays: this only removes the page.
